conceptZh: 橡膠恐龍想煮湯給大家，鍋蓋砰一聲彈開，一堆馬形小玩具和愛心跳出來，組成「媽」，一鍋湯上桌。
object: a rubber dinosaur with enormous feet and tiny arms wearing a warm striped apron, a rattling soup pot, and a toy horse that pops out of it
morph: a pot lid pops open and a tiny toy horse and a woman-shaped ribbon spring out and settle as the glyph 媽
creativeAngle: 驚喜彈出：鍋蓋彈飛、小馬玩具從鍋裡蹦出，加上女字旁的緞帶，組成左女右馬的「媽」；「媽媽」用恐龍穿圍裙煮飯呼應。
promptEn: An 8-second warm and goofy cartoon kitchen clip on a clean solid pale blush backdrop, with one large Traditional Chinese glyph 媽 as the only text, formed of thick glossy saturated plum-purple strokes, about 70% of frame height, centered and uncropped. Lead: a rubber dinosaur with enormous feet and comically tiny arms that cannot reach anything, wearing a warm striped apron; one supporting object, a rattling soup pot with a lid. No background music, no subtitles, no vocabulary text. Voice: warm, friendly off-screen narrator in clear Taiwanese Mandarin saying exactly 媽、媽、媽媽 (ㄇㄚ、ㄇㄚ、ㄇㄚ ㄇㄚ˙); the second syllable of the word takes the neutral tone; slow with clear tones, then stop. Moment 1 (0–1.7s): the dinosaur waddles up to a bubbling soup pot with a tiny wooden spoon, standing on tiptoe, arms far too short to reach in, and as the first 媽 is spoken the pot lid begins to rattle and hop. Moment 2 (1.7–3.4s): the lid pops off with a boing and sails across the frame, bonking the dinosaur on the head; he turns with a double-take just as a long purple ribbon uncoils from the pot and curls into a woman-shaped left part with a swoop, a crossing stroke and a bar, the ribbon wiggling like a happy noodle. Moment 3 (3.4–5s): a tiny toy horse bursts out of the pot with a bounce, stumbles around on the floor, and trots to the right side of the frame, where it flops flat and freezes into the horse part, a boxed body with horizontal lines, legs and a tail of four dots; as the second 媽 is spoken the two pieces click together into 媽. Moment 4 (5s): as 媽媽 is spoken, the dinosaur finally manages to hook the tiny spoon with both feet, sloshes soup into a bowl with a clumsy spin, and carries it over with a proud strut, a little heart floating up from the steam. Final 5–8s: the glyph 媽 stays perfectly still and readable while the dinosaur at the side takes a happy sip, makes a satisfied closed-eye hum, and rocks side to side in his apron, never touching the strokes. Soft daylight, no flashing, no real people, no other text.

conceptZh: 豬探長追著地上的馬蹄印線索，助跑後肚皮滑壘撞倒一排條紋木瓶，木瓶翻滾堆成「媽」字，豬媽媽玩偶從字後面探頭拍拍他的帽子。
object: a stout cartoon detective pig with an oversized magnifying glass, a trail of tiny hoofprint clues, and a row of striped wooden toy skittles standing like bowling pins
morph: the pig belly-slides into the row of skittles; the pins on the left tumble and stack into the woman part 女, the pins on the right spin and fall into the horse part 馬, and the heap settles into the glyph 媽
creativeAngle: 全新保齡球式肚皮滑壘，不再是安靜的廚房擁抱或湯鍋跳馬。線索是馬蹄印，直接呼應「媽」的馬字旁；撞擊本身把木瓶撞成筆畫，動作全程可見。披風英雄不需要，因為撞倒的是一排木瓶，改用一個豬媽媽玩偶在說「媽媽」時探頭拍帽子，聲音與畫面完全對上。
promptEn:
An 8-second bright cartoon slapstick clip on a clean solid pale cream backdrop with a slightly shiny pale mint floor, no background clutter. The only text ever on screen is one large Traditional Chinese glyph 媽, built from thick glossy saturated cherry-red strokes, about 70% of frame height, centered and uncropped. Lead: an original stout cartoon detective pig in a checked deerstalker hat and a tiny trench coat, carrying a round magnifying glass far too big for him, bursting with eager energy. Props: a trail of small dark hoofprint clues on the floor leading right, and a row of tall striped wooden toy skittles standing in the center-right of the frame like bowling pins. One supporting character: a round, soft toy mama pig figure in a flowered apron. No real people, no human figures, no branded characters, no subtitles, no vocabulary text, no music louder than the voice.

Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen voice in clear Taiwanese Mandarin says exactly 媽、媽、媽媽 (ㄇㄚ、ㄇㄚ、ㄇㄚ ㄇㄚ˙), reading precisely those syllables slowly with clear tones, the last syllable of the word light and neutral, then stops with no further speech.

Moment 1, want it (0 to 1.5s): the pig skids in from the far left, presses his huge magnifying glass to the floor and spots the hoofprint trail; his eyes go wide, he points dramatically along the prints to the row of skittles at the far end, then backs up and digs his trotters in like a sprinter. The first 媽 is spoken as he winds up.

Moment 2, try and miss (1.5 to 3s): he charges, dives forward onto his belly, but the giant magnifying glass hits the floor first and he spins on it like a top, whirling in place with dizzy spiral eyes, and stops a whisker short of the pins with his snout squashed flat against the first one. The pins wobble but do not fall. He blinks, tucks the magnifying glass under his hat, and backs up even farther.

Moment 3, the big crash (3 to 4.8s): a longer, faster run-up, a huge belly flop, and he rockets across the slick floor like a bowling ball with a long cartoon motion streak. STRIKE: the skittles fly up with a wooden clatter and squash-and-stretch bounce. The pins on the left tumble and stack into the woman part on the left, a tall swoop, a crossing stroke and a horizontal bar; the pins on the right spin, fall and lock into the horse part on the right, a boxed upright body with its short horizontal lines, the hooked leg and a row of four dots underneath. The second 媽 is spoken exactly as the last pin clicks into place and the whole heap settles into the finished glyph 媽, sharp and still.

Moment 4, payoff (4.8 to 5.8s): the pig pops up at the bottom left in a proud strike pose, one trotter in the air, hat askew, big dazed grin. As 媽媽 is spoken, the soft toy mama pig figure peeks out from behind the right edge of the glyph, waddles over without touching the strokes, straightens his hat and pats his head; the pig melts into a happy wobble and a little heart floats up.

Final hold (5 to 8s): the glyph 媽 stays perfectly still, centered and readable for the full last 3 seconds. Off to the lower left, well away from the strokes, the pig does a small victory wiggle and polishes his magnifying glass while the mama pig stands beside him clapping her trotters. Soft even daylight, cheerful saturated colors with no neon and no white blowout, no flashing, no other text or watermark.
